text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen fast approaching,
Special
Week summons Грасс Вандер to
one of the
academy's rooftops.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's there that Спешл Уик declares her

intentions to win.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Грасс Вандер accepts the challenge,
assuring her
rival that she won't hold
anything back either.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Many rivals have accompanied her along
this path
she walks, and the challenge
ahead will surely
allow her to make
another great leap of progress.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
